record.paper: Blow-ups and extensions of trees in tournaments

dossier_meta.paper: Blow-ups and extensions of trees in tournaments
dossier_meta.statement_text: There is an absolute constant $C$ such that for every integer $k$, every $k$-extension of an oriented tree of order $n$ is $C^{k}(2n-2)$-unavoidable.
dossier_meta.context_text: This conjecture is implied by Conjecture 9 (multiplicative stability under vertex addition) together with Sumner's Conjecture 4 (that oriented trees are $(2n-2)$-unavoidable). The paper proves a weaker result in Corollary 25, establishing $(2\cdot 3^{\binom{2k+2}{2}}\cdot|V(F)|)$-unavoidability for $k$-extensions of sufficiently large oriented trees.
